common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished main scene for a cozy mobile pet-camp game. Generate a single full-bleed square image, 1024 x 1024 pixels. Opaque PNG. This is a NEW artwork, not an edit of any earlier image. Do not reuse the centered-tent layout from earlier artwork.

UNIFIED STYLE: premium cozy mobile-game look in the spirit of Pokémon Sleep: soft 3D-rendered cartoon, round chunky shapes, matte clay-like material with gentle subsurface softness, warm cheerful pastel colors, soft daylight from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, clean tidy edges, no hard black outlines, no text, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no borders. Everything is cute, friendly and calm.

PROMPT: A finished main scene for a cozy mobile pet-camp game, square 1:1, in UNIFIED STYLE. Layout inspired by the camp in Pokémon Sleep: a wide, open grassy clearing seen from above at about 45 degrees, filling most of the image. Slightly below the center a stone campfire ring with a small fire and a big round clay cooking pot hanging from a wooden tripod (the pot is the hero of the scene: empty, its wooden lid leaning against the stones). Far away in the upper-left corner of the meadow a cute cozy camping tent with its door open toward the fire. Two small empty food bowls on the grass at the lower right of the fire. A soft band of round forest trees along the top edge, gentle hills and sky beyond. The meadow itself stays clean, flat and even with only tiny flowers and grass texture, because the game pastes decorations onto it: no paths, no rocks, no water, no clutter away from the campsite; a log or two and a lantern right beside the fire are welcome. Warm morning light, calm and inviting, polished like a premium game key visual. No text, no UI, no characters.

Gameplay layout priorities: High downward-looking near-orthographic 45-degree camera, abundant visible tops of objects, consistent object scale everywhere. One flat continuous lawn fills at least 80% of the scene, reaches both side edges and the bottom, with subtle fine uniform grass texture, very few tiny flower flecks. No slopes, islands, mounds or raised platforms. Forest is only a narrow strip along the TOP edge; no trees down the sides or in the meadow. Narrow distant hills and sky above that band are optional.

The TENT is entirely in the FAR UPPER-LEFT CORNER: approximately x=3–28%, y=13–35%, with its open doorway pointing diagonally down-right toward the campfire. It is a separate distant zone, FAR AWAY from the pot, with a large empty grassy gap. Never place the tent in the upper center or directly behind the pot. Keep the upper-middle grass empty. Tent must stay fully inside the square and be clearly recognizable and cozy.

The HERO POT is a plump large round earthenware pot with a thick rim and clearly EMPTY open interior, hanging visibly from a wooden tripod over a small fire encircled by rounded stones. Its belly sits around x=50%, y=57%, a little below center. Pot body about 16–19% of full image width. Tripod and fire together occupy roughly x=34–65%, y=39–73%. Wooden lid leans against the campfire stones. Exactly TWO small EMPTY food bowls sit together on the grass immediately LOWER-RIGHT of the fire, around x=69–79%, y=73–79%. Small flames only. A little firewood may remain directly beside the fire. Keep foreground open.

Warm, welcoming, polished handcrafted soft 3D mobile game quality, inviting 'I want to live here' feeling. No water, no paths or trails, no large grass color patches, no loose stones except fire ring, no scattered decorations, no people or animals, no text or UI. No inset images, no panels or collage.
export: Exact native PNG copies, no resizing, cropping or screenshots. Built-in tool returned 1254x1254 despite the requested 1024x1024.
image_generation_inputs: No reference images passed: newly generated paintings per section 1, not blockout edits.

validation.requested_cli: python scripts/art/check_art.py art/raw/camp/candidates/<id>.png (run separately after every generation)
validation.manifest_limitation: Candidate paths are not in art/manifest.json. The CLI alone skips them, although it prints a passing count.
validation.actual_validation: For each candidate, called check_art.py check_painting with aspect=1.0 and minWidth=1000, and asserted exact square dimensions. Native size 1254x1254, PNG. All passed.
validation.visual_review: Tent far upper-left, clear grassy gap from central hanging empty clay pot, two empty bowls lower-right of fire, no water or paths, forest only across top.

candidates.variant_prompt: VARIANT 01 — Honey-orange canvas retreat. A cozy classic cream canvas A-frame tent with apricot-orange trim and tied-open flaps, rotated diagonally toward the fire from the FAR UPPER-LEFT. Warm terracotta earthenware hero pot with a pale cream rim and two stout handles. Fresh pistachio lawn, rounded lime and sage forest band at top, powder-blue distant hills. Luminous fresh morning light from upper left, soft gentle shadows and appealing chunky material details.

VARIANT 02 — Dreamy blush bell tent. A compact cream and dusty-pink bell tent with soft conical roof, open peach entrance facing diagonally down-right, entirely in the FAR UPPER-LEFT corner. Big muted jade-green round clay hero pot with ivory rim, suspended from light birch tripod. Very even soft mint-pistachio meadow. Top forest band in eucalyptus and teal, with one small pale blush flowering crown restricted to the back tree band. Airy soft peach morning light from upper left and a small suggestion of lilac hills.

VARIANT 03 — Quiet sage woodland camp. A rounded sage-green dome tent with warm oatmeal doorway, orange trim, and tied-open entrance facing diagonally down-right, far in the UPPER-LEFT corner. Large round warm russet-brown ceramic hero pot with a thick pale oatmeal lip and simple understated glaze band. Exceptionally clean flat spring-green lawn. Compact plump forest crowns at the very top in fern, moss and sage, light lavender hills. Clear diffuse late-morning illumination from upper left, fine ceramic and canvas detail, tranquil understated palette.

VARIANT 04 — Butter-yellow storybook hideaway. A charming cabin-shaped butter-yellow canvas tent with brick-coral edging, rounded gabled roof and warm salmon blanket visible INSIDE its open down-right-facing doorway, fully in the FAR UPPER-LEFT. A big plump slate-blue earthenware hero pot with creamy rim and ochre handle mounts, suspended from a rustic wooden tripod. Smooth clean meadow-green lawn, narrow top-edge crowns in linden, olive and teal with a few gold sunlit tops. Gentle warm clear morning glow from upper left, wonderfully cozy crafted clay rendering.
